definitions.gloss: rust prevention, corrosion prevention, anti-rust treatment
definitions.explanation: The act of preventing rust or corrosion on metal surfaces, or the property of being rust-resistant. Used in automotive, manufacturing, and construction contexts.

examples.japanese: {防錆|ぼうせい}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}す→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{塗料|とりょう}→塗料：24548_toryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{防錆|ぼうせい}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{防錆|ぼうせい}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Since I live near the ocean, rust-prevention measures for my car are essential.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{防|ぼう}→防〜：03967_bou⟧ (prevention, protection) + {錆|せい} (rust, corrosion). Sometimes also read as ぼうさび, using the kun'yomi of ⟦{錆|さび}→錆：03887_sabi⟧. The on'yomi reading ぼうせい is more common in technical and industrial contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防錆|ぼうせい}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧: anti-rust treatment
- {防錆|ぼうせい}⟦{塗料|とりょう}→塗料：24548_toryou⟧: anti-rust paint
- {防錆|ぼうせい}⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧: rust inhibitor
- {防錆|ぼうせい}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: rust-prevention measures
- {防錆|ぼうせい}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: anti-rust effect
- {防錆|ぼうせい}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: anti-rust processing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {耐食|たいしょく}: corrosion resistance — broader term covering resistance to any chemical deterioration
- {錆止|さびど}め: rust prevention — a more colloquial native Japanese word with the same meaning
